RemediationStrings.Title: HardTarget scan completed with errors
RemediationStrings.Description: One or more compliance checks failed to execute. Investigate CheckErrorDetails for root cause.

RemediationStrings.Title: BitLocker must be enabled
RemediationStrings.Description: Full-disk encryption is required. Enable BitLocker on the system drive.

RemediationStrings.Title: BitLocker must use TPM+PIN
RemediationStrings.Description: TPM-only BitLocker auto-unlocks at boot. A pre-boot PIN is required for physical access protection.

RemediationStrings.Title: Secure Boot must be enabled
RemediationStrings.Description: Secure Boot prevents unauthorized bootloaders and rootkits. Enable in BIOS/UEFI settings.

RemediationStrings.Title: Fast Startup must be disabled
RemediationStrings.Description: Fast Startup writes kernel memory to disk at shutdown, creating a forensic artifact.

RemediationStrings.Title: Crash dumps must be disabled
RemediationStrings.Description: Crash dumps write memory contents to disk, exposing credentials and encryption keys.

RemediationStrings.Title: NMI crash dumps must be disabled
RemediationStrings.Description: NMI crash dumps allow physical button press to force a full memory dump.

RemediationStrings.Title: Pagefile must be cleared at shutdown
RemediationStrings.Description: The pagefile may contain credentials and sensitive data. It must be zeroed at shutdown.

RemediationStrings.Title: Kernel must be kept in RAM
RemediationStrings.Description: Kernel paging to disk allows offline extraction of sensitive kernel data.

RemediationStrings.Title: Modern Standby (S0) must be disabled
RemediationStrings.Description: Modern Standby keeps the CPU active during sleep, enabling wake attacks.

RemediationStrings.Title: Connected Standby must be disabled
RemediationStrings.Description: Connected Standby allows network activity and task execution during sleep.

RemediationStrings.Title: Wake timers must be disabled
RemediationStrings.Description: Wake timers bring the device out of sleep to run unattended tasks.

RemediationStrings.Title: Virtualization Based Security must be running
RemediationStrings.Description: VBS provides hardware-backed isolation for credentials and kernel integrity.

RemediationStrings.Title: HVCI (Memory Integrity) must be running
RemediationStrings.Description: HVCI prevents unsigned drivers from loading kernel code.

RemediationStrings.Title: Credential Guard should be running
RemediationStrings.Description: Credential Guard isolates LSASS credentials. Requires Enterprise/Education edition.

RemediationStrings.Title: Remote Desktop must be disabled
RemediationStrings.Description: RDP exposes a network-accessible login surface.

RemediationStrings.Title: Auto-logon must be disabled
RemediationStrings.Description: Auto-logon stores credentials in the registry and bypasses the login screen.

RemediationStrings.Title: ARSO must be disabled
RemediationStrings.Description: ARSO automatically signs in after reboot, leaving the session unlocked.

RemediationStrings.Title: UAC must require password for elevation
RemediationStrings.Description: Consent-only UAC allows silent elevation from an unlocked session.

RemediationStrings.Title: Display timeout must be 5 minutes or less
RemediationStrings.Description: Long or disabled screen timeouts leave the session exposed.

RemediationStrings.Title: Built-in Administrator account must be disabled
RemediationStrings.Description: The built-in Administrator (SID -500) bypasses UAC entirely.

RemediationStrings.Title: Account lockout policy must be configured
RemediationStrings.Description: Without lockout, unlimited brute force attempts at the login screen.

RemediationStrings.Title: Minimum password length must be 8+
RemediationStrings.Description: NIST 800-63B recommends minimum 8 characters. CIS recommends 14 for high-security environments.

RemediationStrings.Title: Ctrl+Alt+Del should be required at login
RemediationStrings.Description: CIS 2.3.7.1: Prevents fake login screen overlays.

RemediationStrings.Title: Last username should be hidden at login
RemediationStrings.Description: CIS 2.3.7.4: Showing the last username gives an attacker half the credential.

RemediationStrings.Title: LSA Protection (RunAsPPL) must be enabled
RemediationStrings.Description: Without RunAsPPL, Mimikatz can dump all credentials from LSASS memory.

RemediationStrings.Title: AutoRun/AutoPlay must be disabled
RemediationStrings.Description: CIS 18.9.8.x: Prevents USB/CD auto-execution of code.

RemediationStrings.Title: Enhanced BitLocker PIN should be enabled
RemediationStrings.Description: Allows alphanumeric PINs, massively increasing keyspace.

RemediationStrings.Title: WinRM must be disabled
RemediationStrings.Description: CIS 18.9.102.x: WinRM enables remote PowerShell. Disable unless required.

RemediationStrings.Title: Kernel debugging must be disabled
RemediationStrings.Description: Kernel debugging gives complete access to all memory and security mechanisms.

RemediationStrings.Title: Test signing must be disabled
RemediationStrings.Description: Test signing allows unsigned kernel drivers, bypassing code integrity.

RemediationStrings.Title: BitLocker Network Unlock must be disabled
RemediationStrings.Description: Network Unlock auto-decrypts on the corporate network without PIN.

RemediationStrings.Title: Activity History must be disabled
RemediationStrings.Description: Activity History records application usage, creating a forensic timeline.

RemediationStrings.Title: Prefetch must be disabled
RemediationStrings.Description: Prefetch records application execution history on disk.
